role: Stages a live GuiScreen (inventory, crafting, furnace, chest, double chest, merchant, death) over the current player for render goldens without changing the world: fills requested inventory slots, builds the screen (a detached TileEntityFurnace, an NpcMerchant with pinned recipes), sets hover and trade selection; capture() reads back the open screen's kind and state for RenderStateProbe. Adds credits (GuiWinGame) and the merchant's name; captures the effects in HashMap order, the preview inputs and stored mouse, the container origin and the credits' clock and lines. Declares MUTATES so a replay re-runs it.
used_by: make -C oracle run CLASS=ScreenSetup (the generic {"cmd":"run","class":"ScreenSetup"} reflection dispatch in Oracle.java)
csrc/engine/raster_hud.c and csrc/tests/hud_live_test.c read the captured guiScreen state (by field name, not by class name)
notes: Only the entry point run(server, cmd), stack() and capture(mc) are static methods; no oracle/src file calls it. The native raster_hud.c link is inferred from the guiScreen/screen fields in hud_live_test.c, not traced through RenderStateProbe's output layout.
